slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Algebra steps in a proof need reasons too. The properties of equality are: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division by the same nonzero number, substitution (replace a quantity with an equal one), reflexive (a = a), symmetric (if a = b then b = a) and transitive (if a = b and b = c then a = c). The distributive property says a(b + c) = ab + ac.

Example: 3x + 5 = 20. Subtract 5 from both sides: 3x = 15 (subtraction property). Divide both sides by 3: x = 5 (division property).
